title: Windows: claude resume/continue freezes and conversations disappear
body:
## Bug Description

On Windows (native, not WSL), `claude resume` and `claude continue` commands cause the screen to freeze and resume conversations become inaccessible.

## Environment

- **OS**: Windows (native terminal and VS Code integrated terminal)
- **WSL**: Works correctly in WSL - issue is Windows-specific

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `claude resume` or `claude continue` on Windows
2. Observe the screen freezes
3. Resume conversations appear briefly then completely disappear
4. Unable to select or resume any previous conversations

## Expected Behavior

- Resume conversations should remain visible and selectable
- `claude resume` and `claude continue` should work without freezing

## Actual Behavior

- Screen freezes when attempting to resume
- Conversations show temporarily then are removed from the list
- Cannot interact with the resume interface at all
- Issue occurs in both:
  - Windows native terminal (CMD/PowerShell)
  - VS Code integrated terminal on Windows

## Workaround

Using WSL instead of native Windows works correctly.

## Additional Context

This appears to be a Windows-specific rendering or terminal interaction issue. The functionality works perfectly in WSL on the same machine.
author: vanman2024
